_comment: How each cosmetic reward looks and where else it comes from. Mileage rewards are listed in mileage_rewards.json (same ids); `meet` rewards come from nights at the car meet (number of visits). Trinket `slot`: mirror (hangs from the rear-view mirror), dash (top of the dash), shelf (parcel shelf), gear (on the gear lever). Livery `mode`: stripes, chequered_roof, scorpion, side_stripe, two_tone. Garage decorations are shown at home (see docs/HOOKS.md).
